locale/likely#

Likely subtags (CLDR): the script and region a language most likely means.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

LikelyLocale(Locale("zh")).locale();       // zh-Hans-CN
LikelyLocale(Locale("sr-ME")).locale();    // sr-Latn-ME

Description#

Likely subtags (CLDR): the script and region a language most likely means.

Public API#

object LikelyLocale#

object LikelyLocale

CLDR add-likely-subtags, explicitly requested. Existing coordinates survive; 'und' supplies the unknown language coordinate. Variants are preserved.

LikelyLocale.LikelyLocale#

LikelyLocale(origin is Locale)

The locale to complete.

LikelyLocale.locale#

locale() is Locale

It with its likely script and region added.
